notes.title: Demo update 2
notes.content:
Changes 0.7.7:

added new bad guy vocalizations (including panic)

reduced some unnecesary AI behaviours

thrown item doesnt collide with minor objects

added associate effect

tutorial skipped after finished game

added door banging before entering room

spell progress won't show after teleport spell in demo

rearranged controls remapping items

added trunk open sound

fixed hotel lobby to room transition

scenery wont damage player

seed slider says random seed if 0

confined mouse settings synchronizes mouse cursor with system cursor

better cigarette puffs

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Update focused on most pressing demo player issues.  



Changes 0.7.6:

added separate finisher button \[F key]

added enemy door banging before entering a room

reception and desert made larger 

fixed teleport sound

fixed fracture door parts blocking player

fixed tutorial issues with Mr. Pink

quieter elevator door sound in cinematic

fixed camera mixing up on finisher and end slo mo

added confined mouse cursor setting (for MHOOK)

fixed sonic the crocodile on hard difficulty

slide on start kicks weapons

fixed being able to zoom during menu/settings

fixed going past door

added bullet icon to HUD

fixed janky finisher controls sometimes

fixed not being able to slide when finisher possible

gib particles stay longer

removed damage from Mr. Yellow roll

fixed inaudible croc death sound

notes.title: Jackal Demo will be fully compatible with Steam Deck on launch
notes.content:
I made extra effort for Jackal to be 100% compatible with Steam Deck on launch, this includes:

* Twin-stick shooter controls
* All content can be accessed with the controller
* Shows Steam Deck glyphs for controls/tutorials
* All interface is legible on the small screen

Demo release date soon to be announced.
MM
